name: prepared_data_suite
description: Gate 3: Validación de datos integrados y preparados antes del Data Warehouse

meta.target_model: Star Schema (fact_violencia_intrafamiliar, dim_geografia, dim_tiempo, dim_victima, dim_medio)

meta.description: Fact table declared grain uniqueness (id_tiempo, id_geografia, id_victima, id_medio).

expectations.notes: DQ-PREP-01: Critical. Fact table uniqueness at declared municipal grain (id_tiempo, id_geografia, id_victima, id_medio).

meta.description: Foreign keys must not be null in fact table.

expectations.notes: DQ-PREP-02: Critical. Zero null foreign keys in fact table.

meta.metric: Orphan foreign keys == 0 across all dimensions
meta.description: Referential integrity: all fact foreign keys must exist in corresponding dimension primary keys.

expectations.notes: DQ-PREP-03: Critical. Referential integrity (fact foreign keys must exist in dimensions).
DQ-PREP-04: Critical. Enriched dim_geografia comisarias_instaladas non-negative.

meta.metric: Reconciliation delta (expected - actual) == 0 for victims and records
meta.description: Measure reconciliation between source extract manifest and prepared fact table.

expectations.notes: DQ-PREP-05: Critical. Reconciliation of measures between source extract and fact table.
